summary: Full backend + frontend validation for Astitva v2 (trust strip, redesigned stats, enriched locations, WhatsApp integration, lead form upgrade w/ budget + thank-you, mobile responsiveness). 34/34 backend pytest pass including 2 new tests for budget field. Frontend: all new sections and data-testids present and integrated. Lead with budget persisted in DB. Mobile (390x844): no horizontal scroll, hamburger drawer with body-scroll lock works, location cards stack, FAB visible.
action_items: Note: review_request example listed 'location-card-park-street' but the third location card is for 'Kolkata' (data-testid=location-card-kolkata). All 3 cards (new-town, rajarhat, kolkata) verified present with starting price + category chip. No code change required — just clarification.
critical_code_review_comments: HomePage.jsx is ~566 lines and growing; consider splitting per section (TrustStrip, StatsSection, Locations, WhatsAppCTA, LeadForm) into separate components for maintainability.
loc.name.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-') only replaces first space — safe today but use replaceAll or regex /\s+/g for future-proofing if a location name contains multiple spaces.
FloatingWhatsApp uses 1.2s setTimeout before showing — fine for UX, but a previous render delay could cause flicker on slow networks. Consider IntersectionObserver-based reveal instead.
Lead form submission lacks visible error state UI for API failures (only console). Worth adding an inline error banner near the submit button.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test lead via UI submit (TEST_lead_*@example.com with budget 'Under ₹50 L') — verified persistence in /api/admin/leads then cleaned up via DELETE.
